# Commands desktop build, graph task-worktree, and review UI updates

On macOS, moz-phab normal `git apply --index` cannot apply D331825's case-only `SearchDialog.js` → `searchDialog.js` rename. `lib/mozphab-review/sitecustomize.py` applies that rename through the index, permitting the required D331825–D331827 parent stack while excluding child D331828. Never silently fall back to `--skip-dependencies`. [Task 4]

Scope: console.
